# solution.SolverProgress { #optyx.solution.SolverProgress }

```python
solution.SolverProgress(
    iteration,
    objective_value,
    constraint_violation,
    elapsed_time,
    x,
)
```

Snapshot of solver state passed to user callbacks during optimization.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name                 | Type                                                                            | Description                                           |
|----------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| iteration            | [int](`int`)                                                                    | Current iteration number.                             |
| objective_value      | [float](`float`)                                                                | Current objective function value (in original sense). |
| constraint_violation | [float](`float`)                                                                | Maximum constraint violation (0.0 if feasible).       |
| elapsed_time         | [float](`float`)                                                                | Wall-clock time since solve started (seconds).        |
| x                    | [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)\[[np](`numpy`).[floating](`numpy.floating`)\] | Current variable values as a numpy array.             |
